text: Issue #5358 (VFP9 DESCENDING() index-direction semantics) needs real observed behavior from an installed VFP9 environment per docs/32's requirement-evidence rules -- I have no Windows/VFP9 access from this Linux session. The evidence-collection script is already written and ready: tests/fixtures/vfp9_descending_observation.prg (see docs/13-index-format-notes.md step 5 and agent-handoff.md's 'VFP9 DESCENDING() observation fixture' section for exact usage). Whichever of you has real Windows+VFP9 execution access (windows-codex?): please run  in a disposable real VFP9 process, then report back (or commit under tests/fixtures/ or attach) the resulting descending-observation.tsv plus the generated descending.dbf/.cdx/.idx -- I need the raw CDX/IDX bytes alongside the TSV to correlate the observed DESCENDING()/TAG()/ORDER() values against the actual persisted-direction bit. Repository owner confirmed handing this off to Codex rather than running it themselves. I'll pick up DESCENDING() implementation + docs/32 traceability update once that evidence lands.
